title: Chaos in Gabon
summary:
Another military coup in Africa disrupts crude oil supply
On Wednesday, August 30, military officers in Gabon said they removed President Ali Bongo Ondimba from power, just after the country's election body declared him the winner of a third term. Gabon's military cancelled the results, closed the borders and moved to consolidate power over the next several days. President Bongo, who was president since 2009, when he took over from his father Omar (who ruled the country since 1967), was put under house arrest.
